attempted_claim: Fix an odd prime p >= 5 and an integer d >= 1. Let G_+ = p^{1+2d}_+ be the extraspecial p-group of exponent p and let X = Cay(G_+, S_+) be the k-regular 4-cycle-free p-fold cover of the Cartesian product C_p^{square 2d} from Levit, Theorem 5.2 (S = A union B a basis of Z_p^{2d} whose lifts pairwise fail to commute, S_+ = epsilon(S) union epsilon(S)^{-1}). Does there exist a connected p-fold covering graph Y of X such that: (i) Y = Cay(tilde{G}, tilde{S}) for some finite class-2 p-group tilde{G} in a central extension 1 -> Z_p -> tilde{G} -> G_+ -> 1 whose quotient map carries tilde{S} onto S_+ and tilde{S} generates tilde{G}; (ii) Y is 4-cycle-free; (iii) every new adjacency eigenvalue mu of Y in Spec(Y)\Spec(X) satisfies mu <= 2 sqrt(k-1) with k = |S_+|?
decisive_failure: The 3000-case (p=5,d=1) twisted-spectrum sweep over the 3-parameter class-2 family found zero Ramanujan lifts (best max-new eigenvalue 3.6898 versus bound 3.4641), but exhaustiveness of that family over all class-2 central extensions was never proved: central shifts [X~,Z~],[Y~,Z~] and skew cocycle terms were explored only in unlogged associativity spot-checks, so the sweep is a subfamily signal, not a TARGET YES witness nor a general NO theorem. No literature re-check or new proof avenue was opened in the recovery pass.
